scope: Semantic review of the supplied exact Word body extraction for DOCX 0090 R05; visual pages, independent hash/extraction re-verification, live PR/blob checks, real association records and formal acceptance were not reviewed.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The three-way fixed-critical summary check has no explicit box for a critical item left unscored under the existing-source/locator-missing HOLD branch or the untraceable-source rejection branch; the separate source-deficiency field and §6.2.3 still determine the outcome, so this is a completeness polish rather than a decision-logic blocker.
nonblocking_findings.locator: §4 fixed-item check and source-deficiency field; §6.1 HOLD row; §6.2.3

nonblocking_findings.finding: P01–P03 and the P05 D+3 retest use page-level synthetic locators rather than row or line locators; row-level locators would speed evaluator traceability.

§7.4's denominator field mixes the five-item scoring denominator with the D+30 cohort 4/6 and does not name the two excluded N/O cases in that field; split individual versus cohort denominators or cross-reference §7.2.
§7.2 cites §6.2 item 6 for a 3/6 error, but 3/6 is primarily the denominator/N/O error in item 4 rather than the percentage-point-versus-relative-percentage formula error in item 6.
The TTQS evaluator user is implicit rather than named; a short evaluator cross-check note would improve direct usability.
